what: A row of white cards fans out around the center card. Side cards step aside by one slot (100%) and sag 15% down, tilting ±8° each around a pivot 500px below the card (up to the fourth slot on wide screens), lined up as if pinned on a wheel rim. Loops endlessly, rolling one slot in 1.4s every 8s, and can also be dragged. Under 768px it curves more tightly: 300px axis, ±15°, 10% sag, up to the second slot (Swiper creative).

options.rotate · y · origin · limit: Tilt (°), sag (%), pivot distance (px) and visible count on wide screens, default 8 · 15 · 500 · 4
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Swiper panel (.swiper > .swiper-wrapper > .swiper-slide) — omitted if the element itself is .swiper

from.note: Original creativeEffect values kept as they are. At 768 and up: limitProgress 4 · translate ±100%,15% · rotate ±8 · origin 50% 500px. Below that: 2 · 10% · ±15 · 300px. speed 1400 · autoplay 8000
